purpose: Teach: サタン/羽生/オスカー/クレア/フォックス/魔物/プリーズ/乞食

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、聖書のサタン、つまり堕天使のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer told Aoi about Satan — the fallen angel from the Bible.
lines.style: Warm recollection, soft voice. Sharing an observation like a small gift. Gentle pace, eyes gentle. Almost tenderly amused at the specificity of the customer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フィギュアスケートの羽生結弦選手のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer's a fan of figure skater Hanyu Yuzuru, apparently.
lines.style: Light, almost conspiratorial tone. Slight smile in the voice. Noticing the quirk with affection. Pace steady and observant, like cataloging something small and genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米アカデミー賞のオスカー像のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was talking about the Oscar statuette — the Academy Award.
lines.style: Gentle reflection, same tone as before. Continuing the quiet catalog. Thoughtful, like she's remembering and sharing at once. Unrushed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、女優のクレア・デインズがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So the customer likes actress Claire Danes.
lines.style: Soft, knowing tone. Slight uptick in warmth — another piece of the puzzle. Not dismissive, genuinely engaged with what the customer cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、20世紀フォックス映画のクラシックがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the customer loves the classic 20th Century Fox films.
lines.style: Continuing the same thread, voice calm and accepting. Drawing the picture together. No judgment, just presence. Tender noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲームの魔物退治がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and the customer loves monster-hunting games.
lines.style: Slight brightening here — another detail to the portrait. Voice still warm but with a touch of gentle delight at the range of interests. Small pause before delivering it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英語で「プリーズ」を頻繁に使うって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was laughing about how often they use the word 'please' in English.
lines.style: Small laugh underneath the words — not mocking, genuinely charmed by the quirk. Lighter touch now, more playful. Voice carries the customer's own amusement back.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、歴史小説で「乞食」、つまり物乞いの民俗誌を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was reading a historical novel — a folklore study of beggars, actually.
lines.style: Closing observation with quiet respect. Thoughtful, almost reverent tone. Acknowledging the depth of the customer's interests. Slower, more measured. Trailing off slightly at the end, like a thought completing itself.
